name: Watch Captain Parker
summary: Guard Parker is a vigilant town guardsman stationed at the Three Corners outpost in the Redridge Mountains. Tasked with patrolling the roads and monitoring aggressive gnoll packs, he serves as an early line of defense for travelers heading into Lakeshire.

sections.title: On Guard at Three Corners
sections.body: Positioned at the vital junction known as Three Corners, Parker keeps watch over the roads connecting Elwynn Forest, Duskwood, and Redridge. With Stormwind's military resources stretched thin and little official reinforcement reaching the region, solo watchmen like Parker carry the burden of keeping the crossroads clear of bandits, prowling predators, and raiding gnolls.

sections.title: Assessing the Gnoll Threat
sections.body: Parker's immediate concern is the gnoll encampments gathering to the north and east of his post. As packs encroach closer toward the roadway, he sends able-bodied travelers to carry word of the gathering gnoll force to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire. The Redridge pack's growing boldness poses an immediate danger to supply convoys and refugees seeking shelter in Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Touch of Warmth
sections.body: Life on a lonely roadside post can be grim, but small kindnesses still find their way to Three Corners. Darcy, the server from the Lakeshire Inn, sends Parker a warm lunch while he is out on patrol. Touched by the gesture, Parker asks the adventurer who delivered it to fetch a bouquet from Lakeshire's herbalist and bring it back to her as a token of his appreciation, without telling the herbalist whom the flowers are from or for.

faq.answer: Parker is stationed at Three Corners, a roadway intersection situated in southwestern Redridge Mountains near the border crossings to Duskwood and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is Parker stationed all the way out at Three Corners?
faq.answer: He is tasked with patrolling the southern roads and keeping a watchful eye on encroaching gnoll packs to keep regional travel and supply routes open into Lakeshire.

faq.q: What threats is Parker monitoring in Redridge?
faq.answer: Parker keeps tabs on the encroaching Redridge gnoll pack threatening the highway, while staying alert to the broader dangers facing the zone, including Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch and Shadowhide gnolls near the Tower of Ilgalar.

faq.q: What is Parker's relationship with Darcy?
faq.answer: Darcy works at the Lakeshire Inn and sends a hot lunch out to Parker at his remote post. In return, Parker has the traveler who brought it pick up flowers from the town herbalist for her, to express his gratitude and affection.

faq.q: Why doesn't Parker receive reinforcements from Stormwind?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and the capital caught up in internal political paralysis, Stormwind has largely left Redridge to fend for itself, forcing local guards and magistrates to rely on roaming adventurers.

faq.q: What quests does Guard Parker offer?
faq.answer: Parker asks adventurers to report the gnoll encampments gathering near the road to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire, and helps arrange a delivery of fresh flowers back to Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn.

angles.text: Parker represents the strained, solitary frontier defense of an Alliance that cannot spare troops to protect its own borders.
For humans of the kingdom, Parker is a reminder of the ordinary sentries striving to hold the kingdom's outlying villages together during a national crisis.
Parker's search for fresh blooms to send to Darcy highlights the quiet value of the local flora blooming across the Redridge hillsides.
